changes: Added annotation-only source coverage bindings in packages/main/src/core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts and packages/main/src/handlers/context.ts for the two signed-workspace gap_analyze requirements. No runtime logic changed.
usage: Run lattice gap_analyze from the repository or story worktree to verify the signed-workspace line 262 and line 311 gaps are no longer reported.
expectedOutcome: lattice gap_analyze shows Gaps: 1 high / 0 medium, with signed-workspace lines 262 and 311 absent and customerKeyRef still listed as Layer4 future scope.
actualTranscript: lattice gap_analyze reported Requirement coverage 100%, Test coverage 100%, Gaps: 1 high / 0 medium. The only remaining high gap is decisions/unlock-layer4-production-safety-suite.md:267 customerKeyRef.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for B-748e; the remaining customerKeyRef gap is intentionally out of scope.
limitations: Layer4 customerKeyRef remains unresolved by design; this story does not implement customerKeyRef, Authority receipt verification, productionDone, fullAuthorityDone, or gitRoot repair UX.
pitfalls: The earlier attempts picked up gitRoot repair UX scope creep; this story fixed only signed-workspace coverage binding and used scope contract enforcement to avoid future-scope expansion.
